study: Warm-start adaptive FCL from the existing frozen model
protocol: Validation-only; no September loading during selection
selection: Screen all specified variants at seed 42. Confirm best validation candidate against baseline at seeds 52 and 62. Retain all runs, including failures and negative results.
novelty_status: Proposed AML-specific combination; replay, distillation, and conflict projection have prior art. No first-in-literature claim.
protocol_note: Separate improvement study starting from the actual existing trained model. Every candidate and the ordinary-FedAvg continuation control receives the same seed-specific frozen checkpoint and four additional rounds. Round zero is eligible to prevent promoting a worse model. Screen and confirmation use August only. This adaptive follow-up was specified after observing runtime/RNG sensitivity in scratch runs. After completing the original five seed-42 variants, logit retention was found harmful. One additional ablation combines risk/context replay with temporal harmonization WITHOUT distillation. It is evaluated before freezing selection or running confirmation seeds; all original outcomes remain present.
